lines.trans: I am sorry—I do not want to merely say thank you to you.
You have helped me so much that the words thank you feel far too light.
There is no need for formalities.
A few days ago I had a heart-to-heart with the chairwoman and told her that apart from my parents, you have influenced me most deeply.
Only now do I truly understand what I meant back then.
In my everyday life, my work, my studies, and my friends all exist because of you.
Without you, I do not even know what kind of person I would become.
So whatever happens in the future, I should never deliberately distance myself from you.
I have no right to act that way, and I do not want to either.
Years ago finding a private photo of you was so hard, yet students today can take photos with you effortlessly.
Senior brother, look this way and let me keep one photo together!
So many people are watching—stop fooling around.
